title: Article 240 — Power of President to make regulations for certain Union territories

Topic at a Glance
Article 240 of the Constitution of India is titled “Power of President to make regulations for certain Union territories”. It forms an integral component of The Union Territories (Articles 239–242), located within the “Union Territories” cluster. Current through the 106th Constitutional Amendment Act, 2023.

Constitutional Text & Anatomy
(1) The President may make regulations for the peace, progress and good government of the Union territory of—
